integrity: Proof supplied for all odd primes and all admissible parameters; finite code tests are corroborative, independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: An isogeny result; not an isomorphism of principally polarized varieties. The full Ekedahl--Oort type and scheme structure of the isotropic kernel are not determined. The decomposition technique is classical and implicit-priority risk remains.
title: A polarized \(p\)-isogeny and supersingular but non-superspecial Jacobians in a double Artin--Schreier family
